title: Branch/remote policy engine (develop<->master, clone/fork)
objective: ADR-0001 §3: policy module resolving clone-vs-fork, base=develop, trunk=master. Enforce: branch off origin/<base> after fetch only, never push trunk directly, ff develop->trunk after merge. Fork model deferred behind remote.model=fork.
acceptance_criteria: Branch/remote policy engine (develop<->master, clone/fork): implemented + cargo test green + checkpointed
